subject: Archaeology
title: Graham Hancock and the Lost Civilization
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Graham Hancock and the Lost Civilization.

hook.text: A bestselling author claims an advanced civilization existed during the Ice Age and was wiped out.

buildup.text: Graham Hancock argues that Göbekli Tepe, the Sphinx, and underwater ruins prove a lost global civilization existed.

discovery.text: His Netflix show 'Ancient Apocalypse' reached millions. Archaeologists called it the most dangerous show on television.

twist.text: Hancock accuses archaeologists of a cover-up. In reality, scholars publish all findings openly and welcome peer review.

climax.text: The appeal is emotional: a mystery bigger than experts admit. But extraordinary claims require extraordinary evidence.

punchline.text: Millions of viewers, zero peer-reviewed papers. Popularity is not proof.

quiz.question: Why do archaeologists criticize Graham Hancock's claims?
options: He refuses to visit any archaeological sites in person
His claims lack peer-reviewed evidence and accuse scholars of a cover-up
He only focuses on European sites and ignores the rest of the world
